name: save-boot-8a-world-midgar-diag
description: Diagnostic for #140 (why the save-booted world map did not move under the pad in #80 attempt 3). Signs only (-1/0/1) for positions and angles; no coordinate leaves the run. Load as save-boot-7-world-kalm does (Circle every 30 frames until g_GameState 3). From the outside-Midgar save instead (harness/saves/disc1-wm0-midgar.json), to see whether the entry point matters. Then 600 frames, a mark, 120 frames of Up and 10 still. Reported as in save-boot-7a-world-kalm-diag.

wl_state.description: World overlay D_800E566C (s32, low half): the world loop's state. WORLD_Main sets it to -15 and WmUpdateWorldState counts it up to 0, then sets 1 (playing) and starts the fade-in; 2 is the menu, 3/8 a field or battle exit, >= 6 leaves the loop. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c WORLD_Main, WmUpdateWorldState.

frame_d.description: World overlay D_8011650C (s32, low half): the frame step, set to 2 by WmLoadTxzDataAndInit; movement code branches on it. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c.

atype.description: Player actor (pool element 7) + 0x50 actorType: the world model (WmGetModelIdFromPcEntity). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.h WorldActor.
